title: Segment force-displacement
summary: Load motion segments and whole discs slowly as stated; report compression force-displacement curves, shear and other stiffness, translation or rotation.
simulate: Build the specimen of the simulation (motion segment intact or without posterior elements, disc with its vertebral bodies, or L1-S1); fix the lower vertebra.
Apply the preload first, then the single test load or displacement of the task; other DOF free unless stated.
Measure at the reference point stated (upper vertebral body centre or disc centre).
Compression: one force-displacement curve (impose displacement, report force) covering the listed displacements and loads; preload simulations: repeat at each listed preload.
Matrix terms: impose one DOF at a time with the others held (diagonal only). Report one curve per output over the sweep, one number where there is no sweep.

outputs.label: Translational stiffness
outputs.definition: Stiffness = force / translation along the loaded direction, slope over the stated range (N/mm)

outputs.label: Rotational stiffness
outputs.definition: Stiffness = moment / rotation about the loaded axis, slope over the stated range (Nm/deg)

outputs.label: Translation under load
outputs.definition: Translation of the upper vertebra relative to the lower at the stated load (mm)

outputs.label: Rotation under load
outputs.definition: Rotation of the upper vertebra relative to the lower at the stated load (deg)

outputs.label: Bending moment, % of elastic-limit moment
outputs.definition: Flexion moment at the stated % of the elastic-limit angle (10.5°), as % of the moment at that limit

outputs.label: Axial compressive force
outputs.definition: Axial compressive force on the upper vertebra at the stated axial displacement (N); displacement counted from the zero-load position (or from the preloaded position when a preload is stated)

outputs.label: Shear stiffness
outputs.definition: Shear force / shear displacement of the upper vertebra, 0-150 N, 2nd cycle, 500 N preload (N/mm)

outputs.label: Shear strength
outputs.definition: Peak anterior shear force, displacement at 0.5 mm/s to failure, 500 N preload (kN)

studies.loading: Displacement control, one DOF at a time: ±0.35 mm axial, ±0.5 mm shear, ±1-1.5° rotation, 4 sawtooth cycles of 87 s; axial preload 0, 250 or 500 N; L2-L3/L4-L5

studies.sample: 11 thoracic FSUs, one per level T1-T2 to T11-T12
studies.loading: Load control, one load at a time: forces to ~157 N (16 kp), moments to ~6 N·m; no preload; read after 4 min creep; values at 100 N / 5 N·m; T1-T12 FSUs

studies.sample: 14 lumbar FSUs, Thompson grade 3-5, then isolated discs
studies.loading: Hybrid control, axial compression, 8 haversine cycles at 0.1 Hz to 1.1 MPa-equivalent; 0.5 MPa-eq. follower preload; 37 °C; lumbar FSUs, then isolated discs

studies.sample: same 14 lumbar FSUs, split by degeneration grade
studies.loading: Displacement control, haversine 0.6 mm shear, 5° flex, 2° ext, 3° LB, 2° AR (or 1.1 MPa-eq. compression), 0.1 Hz; 0.5 MPa-eq. follower preload; lumbar FSUs

studies.sample: 9 lumbar disc units (L1-L2 to L3-L4), posterior elements removed

studies.sample: 7 T1-T2 FSUs with rib heads
studies.loading: Displacement control, pure AP shear to ~200 N at 1-100 mm/s; 5 N shear preload; no axial preload; T1-T2 with rib heads

studies.sample: 42 lumbar FSUs; 18 retested without posterior elements
studies.loading: Load control, static dead weights: compression to 400 N, or shear to 205 N in 3+ steps on a 400 N axial preload; read after 15 s creep; lumbar FSUs

studies.sample: 12 thoracolumbar FSUs (11 T12-L1, 1 L1-L2)
studies.loading: Load control, 500 N at 50 N/s with 10 s hold: axial compression or shear through mid-disc (AP, lateral); no preload; T12-L1 FSUs

studies.sample: 11 lumbar FSUs, grade III discs, preload 0-4400 N
studies.loading: Load control, 4 steps of 40 N / 4 N·m (60 s hold each), read at 80 N shear or 8 N·m; axial preload 0 or 2200 N (0-4400 N tested); lumbar FSUs L1-L5

studies.sample: 6 lumbar disc-only units (DS1), posterior elements removed

studies.loading: Load control, follower compressive load 0-1200 N (neutral or flexed-posture path) applied in a fixed posture, no moment; L1-S1 spines

studies.sample: 14 L2-L3 and L4-L5 joints, 8 cadavers, grade 1-2
studies.loading: Load control, 3 equal static steps to 90 N shear, 823 N compression or 11.2-14.7 N·m, read after 1-2 min creep; no preload (nucleus at 626 kPa); L2-L3/L4-L5

studies.sample: 12 FSUs (6 L1-L2, 6 L3-L4); 4-6 per load mode

studies.sample: 10 L4-L5 segments (42 lumbar segments in study)
studies.loading: Displacement control, flexion in 1° steps to the elastic limit (~10.5°), 2 s per cycle, with combined compression rising to ~925 N; L4-L5 FSUs

studies.sample: 6 lumbar disc-vertebra units (2 L2-L3, 4 L4-L5), 34-47 y, posterior elements removed
studies.loading: Displacement control at 5 mm/min between 200 N tension and 1000 N compression, 5 cycles, last reported; no preload; lumbar discs (posterior elements removed)

studies.sample: 5 lumbar anterior column units (disc + vertebral bodies), 59-85 y
studies.loading: Displacement control, triangular axial impacts to 0.8 mm in 80-1000 ms (1000 ms ~1.6 mm/s); 50 N preload; 50 precond. cycles; lumbar discs, no posterior arch

studies.sample: lumbar discs with vertebral bodies; min/average/max curves via Ghezelbash 2020a Fig 4a
studies.loading: Axial compression of lumbar disc-body units to ~1.8 mm; rate and preload not given in the secondary source (per review)

studies.sample: 6 lumbar disc segments with facets removed, grade II-III
studies.loading: Load control, AP shear cycles ±200 N at 50 N/s (stiffness 0-150 N), then 0.5 mm/s anterior shear to failure; 500 N axial dead weight; lumbar discs, no facets

agent_prompt: Use your finite element spine model. Run the 54 simulations in `simulations`. Build the specimen (motion segment intact or without posterior elements, disc with its two vertebral bodies, or L1-S1 for follower tests), fix the lower vertebra, apply the preload first, then the test load. The compression simulation is one test for all studies: impose axial compressive displacement (mm) and report the axial force (N) as one curve up to the largest listed displacement and the listed loads; force-controlled studies are scored at their measured displacement. Preload simulations: repeat the test at each listed preload. Other simulations: apply the single test load or displacement in `fixed`/`at` with the other DOF free (held fixed for 6x6 diagonal terms) and report stiffness (k_lin N/mm, k_rot Nm/deg) over the stated range, flexibility (mm/N, deg/Nm), translation (mm) or rotation (deg) at the stated load, shear stiffness (N/mm) or strength (kN); moment_pct = flexion moment at the given % of 10.5 deg as % of the moment at 10.5 deg. Run each simulation once, sweeping the input in `sweep` over all its listed values (start from the unloaded state; a denser curve is fine), and record every listed output. Return one JSON object following answer_format: per simulation id, one curve [[x, y], ...] per output (x = the sweep input; it is read by linear interpolation and listed x values outside your curve fail), or one number where there is no sweep or the output is marked scalar; null where your model cannot run it. Do not tune the model to the reference values.
